summary.text: Food path true inheritance is a food path cultivation legacy. Early scenes show Spectral Soul Demon Venerable holding one taken from a beastman Gu Immortal.

claims.text: In Earth Abyss, the beastman Gu Immortal who created food path holds the inheritance himself after Barbarian Jiu Lie failed to take it from him by force, and during Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s eating test he says he agreed with Barbarian Jiu Lie to pass the food path inheritance to future humans rather than to him, on condition that the inheritor endures that test. He then says he broke that agreement after a thousand years of eating dao marks, and that Spectral Soul is the two hundred and seventieth person he has deceived. Eaten down to his head, Spectral Soul tells the beastman Gu Immortal that a part of his own soul was in every piece of flesh the beastman swallowed, and the beastman Gu Immortal dies.
Fang Yuan judges that Spectral Soul Demon Venerable used that food path true inheritance to create the soul devouring method and steal others’ cultivation memories and experiences.

While talking with Lang Ya land spirit, Fang Yuan notes that Spectral Soul’s main body should know many food path methods because he inherited a food path true inheritance in life, but that the main body is trapped in the giant dream realm and hard to draw from.

Fang Yuan concludes that Black Tigress is aligned with Shadow Sect, which has food path true inheritances, and that only such a non-standard path could pierce his defensive divination tortoise transformation.

The Immortal Gu recipe of snack Immortal Gu comes from Shadow Sect; its source is Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, who in life killed the beastman Gu Immortal and obtained that Gu Immortal’s food path true inheritance. Narration states that the beastman Gu Immortal is the legendary figure who created food path, and that the food path true inheritance in Fang Yuan’s hands is the most authentic one in the world. With it, Fang Yuan knows snack Immortal Gu’s usage limits and recovery needs. He treats the gain as coming from his great enemy Shadow Sect and as the best food path true inheritance in the world.

After copper dragonfish appear in treasure yellow heaven, Gu Immortals deduce that the seller has a food path true inheritance, call such inheritances something most experts want, and try to buy it from Fang Yuan’s will; he ignores them so he will not fuel future enemies, including Heavenly Court.

In Heavenly Court, Fairy Zi Wei holds an iron dragonfish while relevant memories surge from Spectral Soul, and she states that with that portion of the food path true inheritance Heavenly Court can also produce iron, copper, silver, and gold dragonfish and change the situation in treasure yellow heaven.

Zui Xian Weng accepts an inheritance that holds Green Ant Ascetic’s enslavement path inheritance and Wine Fairy’s food path true inheritance, and he values Wine Fairy’s portion far above the enslavement path line.

Fang Yuan states that he originally had a food path true inheritance from Shadow Sect, the original food path inheritance in the world, and that he later also gained Southern Border’s Paradise Earth true inheritance with further food path killer moves.

Holders.text: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable Fang Yuan Zui Xian Weng
